tuning.scope: Pilot manual annotation: left view of First AutoNav, frames 0/10/20; visible individual rocks with bbox width >=30 and height >=20 pixels. Smaller stones and boundary-truncated objects excluded; preliminary visual labels, not a validated benchmark.
tuning.tracking_note: ID switches between successive matches of an annotated ID, including gaps; not IDF1/MOTA.

validation.scope: Provisional manual visual labels on reserved same-video NASA frames 5/15/25/35, before examining predictions. Individual visible rocks >=30x20 pixels; small stones, dunes, rover hardware and boundary-truncated objects excluded. Assistant annotations require human review; not an independent benchmark.
validation.tracking_note: Detection-only annotations; identities were not labeled.

metrics.cpu_percent_note: process CPU can exceed 100% on multicore

model_resources.confidence_semantics: Grounding DINO detector score; not calibrated probability
model_resources.provider_note: DirectML accelerates supported operators; unsupported/shape operators may execute on CPU.

tiling.note: Internal crop-edge boxes excluded; overlapping views merged by NMS.

notes: Playback FPS is not original sensor capture cadence.
Processing latency includes inference, association, JSON serialization; excludes preview encoding.
Model loading excluded; first inference included. RSS sampled once per frame.
Uncalibrated observations have null camera and rover position; no metric coordinates inferred.

decision: Expose crops as opt-in: tuning recall improves but five inference calls increase latency. No default latency regression.
